import MumfordLib.BarycentricSubdivisionChainMap
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionProducer

/-!
# Barycentric subdivision of integral singular chains

Affine subdivision commutes with the boundary, and affine naturality identifies
its restriction to a face. Evaluating these identities along singular simplices
gives a natural endomorphism of the integral singular chain complex.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- Barycentric subdivision commutes with the singular boundary. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem singularSubdivision_comm (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    singularSubdivision X (n + 1) ≫ (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 1) n =
      (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 1) n ≫ singularSubdivision X n := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro σ
  change singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _ = singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _
  rw [singularSimplexChain_subdivision_assoc]
  rw [(affineSingularEvaluation (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n + 1⦌) σ)).comm]
  rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivision (n + 1) (n + 1)),
    barycentricSubdivision_comm]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [vertexListChain_boundary_assoc, singularSimplexChain_boundary_assoc]
  simp only [Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.zsmul_comp,
    singularSimplexChain_face_subdivision]

/-- Barycentric subdivision as an endomorphism of the singular chain complex. -/
def singularSubdivisionChainMap (X : TopCat) :
    IntegralSingularChainComplex X ⟶ IntegralSingularChainComplex X :=
  ChainComplex.ofHom (singularSubdivision X) (singularSubdivision_comm X)

@[simp]
theorem singularSubdivisionChainMap_f (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularSubdivisionChainMap X).f n = singularSubdivision X n := rfl

/-- The subdivision chain map is natural in the topological space. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem singularSubdivisionChainMap_naturality {X Y : TopCat} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    singularSubdivisionChainMap X ≫
        SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map f) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) =
      SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map f) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) ≫
        singularSubdivisionChainMap Y := by
  ext n : 1
  exact singularSubdivision_naturality f n

end Mumford.Analytic
